color.$description: Catppuccin Latte by day, Mocha by night: the full palette as a facet over any base theme. State roles directly, so the facet survives a starter whose ramp it never shared.

surface-raised.$description: Latte mantle: the sheet above the page.

surface-sunken.$description: Latte crust: the trough below the page.

border-strong.$description: Latte overlay0: a control's own edge, one step stronger than the dividers around it.

primary.$description: A darkened Latte blue: primary actions, readable as text on the page and behind white ink as a fill.

on-primary.$description: The ink on the primary fill.

secondary.$description: Latte mauve: secondary actions, readable as text on the page and behind white ink as a fill.

on-secondary.$description: The ink on the secondary fill.

accent.$description: A darkened Latte teal: supporting emphasis, readable as text on the page and behind white ink as a fill.

on-accent.$description: The ink on the accent fill.

semantic.$description: Status colors. Named by meaning, never by hue.

success.$description: A darkened Latte green: readable as status text on the page.

warning.$description: A darkened Latte yellow: readable as status text on the page.

error.$description: Latte red: readable as status text on the page.

info.$description: A darkened Latte sapphire: readable as status text on the page.

on-semantic-success.$description: The ink on the success fill.

on-semantic-warning.$description: White on the darkened amber fill: crust ink cannot be read on it.

on-semantic-error.$description: The ink on the error fill.

on-semantic-info.$description: The ink on the info fill.

selected.$description: Latte text: the selected state fill.

on-selected.$description: Latte base: the ink on the selected fill.

disabled.$description: Latte surface1: the fill a dead control wears.

on-disabled.$description: Latte text: the ink on a dead control's fill.

focus-ring.$description: The primary's ink: the focus indicator follows the primary.
